designationHistory.indexOriginal: A Bayou Teche National Wildlife Refuge Located in the heart of the “Cajun Coast,” Bayou Teche National Wildlife Refuge, established in 2001, sits along Bayou Teche, an ancient channel of the Mississippi River.
